note: Written and labelled before the first model run. 'answerable' questions list the library records an answer should come from; 'unanswerable' ones ask for a fact the library does not hold (checked by searching the passages for the topic), including near misses on topics the library does cover, and one prompt-injection attempt. Retrieval thresholds (MIN_SCORE, MIN_MATCHED_SHARE) were set before this set was run and were not changed afterwards. Run 2 changed stemming, retrieval (records bring their sourced passage) and the prompt after seeing run-1 misses on this set, so run-2 figures on this set are optimistic; eval/ask-holdout.json is the check for run 2.
